question: NRDF is related to PMFA in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, SFJW is related to UALR. To which of the given options is GVKQ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png]
